records.record: Filed under the 1974 Act. Two interlocutory applications pending; the second seeks a stay of the first. Hearing listed for the autumn list.
Possession sought on the ground of non-payment. The tenant has deposited arrears and the matter now turns on costs.
Lease renewed for eleven years with a revised premium. No appeal filed within the limitation period.
